lines.trans: For the first time I liked a dish!
You don't have the ingredient? Why didn't you order it? You messed up, huh?
Dima, let me make you something of my own.
I just want that dish that I liked in the afternoon.
Fine, I will bring you that dish.
Excuse me. Only I will name the very important ingredient for you.
It was you! You did it, right?
Who put this on my plate?
That was not made for you.
For whom?
For these two. They started it first.
Fedya came up with all of it, he brought the ram in.
